Name: Parts Counted
Expression:
CALCULATE(
        DISTINCTCOUNT(jdis_Phy_Inv[Part No]),
        YEAR(jdis_Phy_Inv[Stocktake Date]) = YEAR(TODAY())
    )

Name: Weeks Remaining
Expression:
VAR CurrentWeek = WEEKNUM(TODAY())
VAR WeeksInYear = 52
RETURN WeeksInYear - CurrentWeek

Name: Bins To Count Per Week
Expression:
VAR TotalBins = [Total Bins]  
VAR WeeksInYear = 52
RETURN DIVIDE(TotalBins, WeeksInYear, 0)

Name: On Track % Bins1
Expression: [Bins To Count Per Week] * [Weeks Passed] / [Total Bins]

Name: OnTrackColorCode
Expression:
SWITCH(
    TRUE(),
    [Target % Bins] < 0.75 || [Target % Parts] < 0.75, 1,
    ([Target % Bins] >= 0.70 && [Target % Bins] < 0.9) || ([Target % Parts] >= 0.70 && [Target % Parts] < 0.9), 2,
    ([Target % Bins] >= 0.9 && [Target % Bins] < 1) || ([Target % Parts] >= 0.9 && [Target % Parts] < 1), 3,
    [Target % Bins] >= 1 || [Target % Parts] >= 1, 4,
    BLANK()
)

Name: On Track % Parts1
Expression:
VAR AvgPartsPerWeek = [Parts To Count Per Week]
VAR WeeksPassed = [Weeks Passed]
VAR TotalParts = [Total Parts]
VAR Calculatio = AvgPartsPerWeek * WeeksPassed
RETURN
    DIVIDE(Calculatio, TotalParts)

Name: CalculationByBranchParts
Expression: ROUND([Parts To Count Per Week] * [Weeks Passed], 0)

Name: CalculationByBranchBin
Expression: ROUND([Bins To Count Per Week] * [Weeks Passed], 0)

Name: BinsNotCounted
Expression:
VAR CurrentYear = YEAR(TODAY())
VAR BinsList = 
    CONCATENATEX(
        FILTER(
            VALUES(jdis_Phy_Inv[Bin]),
            NOT (
                CALCULATE(
                    COUNTROWS(jdis_Phy_Inv),
                    YEAR(jdis_Phy_Inv[Stocktake Date]) = CurrentYear
                ) > 0
            )
        ),
        jdis_Phy_Inv[Bin],
        ", "
    )
RETURN
BinsList

Name: Show Filter 1
Expression:
VAR MaxFilters = 3
RETURN
    IF (
        ISFILTERED ( Dim_Branch[Branch] ),
        VAR ___f =
            FILTERS ( Dim_Branch[Branch] )
        VAR ___r =
            COUNTROWS ( ___f )
        VAR ___t =
            TOPN ( MaxFilters, ___f, Dim_Branch[Branch] )
        VAR ___d =
            CONCATENATEX ( ___t, Dim_Branch[Branch], ", " )
        VAR ___x =
            "Branch:  " & ___d
                & IF ( ___r > MaxFilters, ", ... [" & ___r & " items selected]" ) & " "
        RETURN
            ___x & UNICHAR ( 13 )
                & UNICHAR ( 10 )
    )

Name: ShowFilterBranch
Expression:
IF (
    ISFILTERED ( Dim_Branch[Branch] ),
    VAR _Location =
        VALUES ( Dim_Branch[Branch] )
    VAR _Itemscombined =
        CONCATENATEX ( _Location, Dim_Branch[Branch], UNICHAR ( 10 ) )
    RETURN
        _Itemscombined & UNICHAR ( 10 ),
    ""
)

Name: Parts with Qty Counted
Expression:
CALCULATE(
    DISTINCTCOUNT(jdis_Phy_Inv[Part No]),
    jdis_Phy_Inv[Bin Qty] > 0,
    YEAR(jdis_Phy_Inv[Stocktake Date]) = YEAR(TODAY())
)

Name: Parts with Qty Left to Count
Expression: [Total Parts with Qty] - [Parts with Qty Counted]

Name: Parts with Qty % Counted
Expression:
DIVIDE(
    [Parts with Qty Counted],
    [Total Parts with Qty],
    0
)

Name: % Parts with Qty Counted
Expression: DIVIDE([Parts with Qty Counted], [Total Parts with Qty], 0)

Name: CalculationByBranchPartsWithQty
Expression: ROUND([Parts with Qty To Count Per Week] * [Weeks Passed], 0)

Name: Parts with Qty To Count Per Week
GaugeColor Parts with Qty
Expression:
IF(
    [% Parts with Qty Counted] < [Target % Parts with Qty], 
    "Red", 
    "Green"
)

Name: Bin Qty Counted
Expression:
CALCULATE(
    SUM(jdis_Phy_Inv[Bin Qty]),
    YEAR(jdis_Phy_Inv[Stocktake Date]) = YEAR(TODAY())
)

Name: Bin Qty To Count Per Week
CalculationByBranchBinQty
Expression: ROUND([Bin Qty To Count Per Week] * [Weeks Passed], 0)

Name: GaugeColor Bin Qty
Expression:
IF(
    [% Bin Qty Counted] < [Target % Bin Qty], 
    "Red", 
    "Green"
)

Name: Is Uncounted This Year
Expression:
IF(
    HASONEVALUE(jdis_Phy_Inv[Part No]),
    IF(
        ISBLANK(MAX(jdis_Phy_Inv[Stocktake Date])) || 
        YEAR(MAX(jdis_Phy_Inv[Stocktake Date])) < YEAR(TODAY()),
        1,
        0
    ),
    BLANK()
)

Name: Is Bin Uncounted This Year
Expression:
IF(
    HASONEVALUE(jdis_Phy_Inv[Bin]),
    IF(
        ISBLANK(MAX(jdis_Phy_Inv[Stocktake Date])) || 
        YEAR(MAX(jdis_Phy_Inv[Stocktake Date])) < YEAR(TODAY()),
        1,
        0
    ),
    BLANK()
)
